title: toona febrifuga var. glabrior
intro: Toona febrifuga var. glabrior, commonly known as a variety of the Australian native tree Toona febrifuga, is a plant species that belongs to the mahogany family (Meliaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Toona febrifuga var. glabrior are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic agent, which helps to alleviate symptoms associated with fever and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
